# More Trees

More Trees is a sustainability-focused platform planting trees on behalf of individuals or businesses aiming to offset carbon footprints and support reforestation

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/more-trees/.

## Actions

- **Get Total Carbon Offset** (read-only): This tool retrieves the total carbon offset and other forest-related information for the authenticated user.
